description: This file defines a comprehensive onboarding user interface for an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes multiple steps such as welcome, gateway connection setup, permission granting, and final review. The code handles user interaction, permission management, QR code scanning for gateway setup, and displays connection status. It also manages various configuration states related to gateway endpoints and user permissions.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: Enum class representing different steps of the onboarding process.

classes.name: GatewayInputMode
classes.description: Enum class defining modes of manual gateway input—setup code or manual host/port.

classes.name: PermissionToggle
classes.description: Enum listing different permission toggles that can be enabled/disabled during onboarding.

classes.name: SpecialAccessToggle
classes.description: Enum for toggling special access permissions like notification listener.

methods.name: OnboardingFlow
methods.description: Main composable function orchestrating the onboarding process with multiple steps, handling state, user interactions, and permission management.

methods.name: canFinishOnboarding
methods.description: Determines if onboarding can be completed based on connection status.

methods.name: onboardingPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Provides button colors for primary action buttons.

methods.name: onboardingTextFieldColors
methods.description: Provides color scheme for text input fields.

methods.name: onboardingSwitchColors
methods.description: Provides color scheme for switch toggles.

methods.name: StepRail
methods.description: Displays the progress indicator for onboarding steps.

methods.name: WelcomeStep
methods.description: Displays initial welcome and feature overview cards.

methods.name: GatewayStep
methods.description: Handles user input for gateway setup, including QR code scanning, manual URL entry, and configuration.

methods.name: GuideBlock
methods.description: Reusable UI component for displaying informational guides.

methods.name: GatewayModeToggle
methods.description: UI for toggling between setup code and manual input modes.

methods.name: GatewayModeChip
methods.description: UI button for selecting gateway input mode.

methods.name: QuickFillChip
methods.description: Quick fill buttons for common gateway host configurations.

methods.name: ResolvedEndpoint
methods.description: Displays a resolved endpoint URL with visual separation.

methods.name: StepShell
methods.description: Container for each onboarding step with a titled shell.

methods.name: InlineDivider
methods.description: Horizontal divider used inline in forms.

methods.name: PermissionsStep
methods.description: UI for requesting user permissions and toggles for various system features.

methods.name: PermissionToggleRow
methods.description: Represents a toggle row for a specific permission with status indication.

methods.name: FinalStep
methods.description: Review and confirm details before finalizing onboarding and establishing connection.
